name: Badminton Coach
summary:
Badminton Coach, a VR Badminton trainer by Smashville, builds on our initial free demo that focused on the drop shot. Badminton Coach has added new and improved physics as well as drop, drive, skills, and self-coach training scenes. Our live Coach Connect allows your own coach to connect from anywhere in the world and direct your training verbally, and even feed you birdies to the front, middle and back, on either the left, right or center court.
